sn35.74:11.1: The expression _rāgavirāga_ plays on two senses of the word. The root sense of _rāga_ is “dye” or “color”, especially red (cf. _rajaka_, [mn56:27.14]()) . From there it took on the sense “greed, lust, passion” which dominates in Pali. Thus _rāgavirāga_ is both the “fading of color” and the “dispassion of passion”. It is a term for the quelling of harmful emotions ([an2.31]()).
